questions.title: If the Boston Celtics agree to trade Jaylen Brown by July 31, 2026, which NBA team will be his destination?
questions.background: Jaylen Brown plays for the Boston Celtics and was named the 2024 NBA Finals MVP.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Reporting by ESPN or The Associated Press identifying an agreed trade involving Jaylen Brown between June 1 and July 31, 2026. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the team designated to receive Brown under the first such publicly reported agreement. An agreement counts even if league approval or completion remains pending. Accepted Answer Format : The full name of the NBA team.
questions.current_reasoning: Major June 26 reporting reshapes the Jaylen Brown destination market: ESPN's Shams Charania reported on Friday, June 26 that the 'majority of Boston's conversations have been with Western Conference teams,' explicitly singled out the Portland Trail Blazers as having 'a lot of interest in Brown,' and noted Boston is asking for at least four first-round picks in some cases (while The Athletic's Jon Krawczynski confirmed Boston sought Rudy Gobert, Naz Reid, and picks from Minnesota before the Wolves acquired LaMelo Ball). Portland surges from 0.07 to 0.21 given Shams's spotlight, its Western Conference fit, young center Donovan Clingan ('hunting a big man'), and Milwaukee's future first-round picks. Houston trims from 0.25 to 0.19 after Zach Lowe reported hearing the Rockets are 'not super into Jaylen Brown' (offsetting Brett Siegel's confirmation of direct outreach alongside New Orleans). New Orleans edges up to 0.17 as a confirmed Western Conference suitor with reported Celtics interest in Trey Murphy III. Atlanta drops to 0.10 given Shams's Western Conference emphasis and the Hawks keeping #8. Detroit Pistons (0.06) replace the Los Angeles Clippers (zero insider trade-talk links) after Marc Stein and Jake Fischer reported on June 26 they were 'advised not to rule out' a Jalen Duren sign-and-trade for Brown, even though Chris Haynes reported Detroit is conveying Duren won't be moved. 27% remains on the rest of the NBA.

questions.title: Which month will the Palestinian Football Association announce for the resumption of its football competitions after their October 2023 suspension?
questions.background: Palestinian football competitions have been suspended since the war in Gaza began in October 2023.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official Palestinian Football Association announcement, or reliable news reporting quoting its leadership. Resolution Conditions : Use the first public announcement between July 1 and August 31, 2026, that specifies a date for restarting the suspended football competitions. Resolve to the calendar month containing that announced restart date, regardless of whether competitions subsequently begin as scheduled. If no qualifying announcement occurs by the deadline, the question is void. Accepted Answer Format : The full English name of the month, not the month in which the announcement is made.
questions.current_reasoning: Gaza hosted a PFA-supervised 5-a-side recovery tournament in Feb–Mar 2026 following the Oct 2025 ceasefire, while Al Jazeera reported on June 14, 2026 that the West Bank / Palestine Professional League remains suspended with hopes of a scaled-down revival 'after the summer break concludes.' Historically the Palestinian domestic season begins in late August or September, and an announcement made between July 1 and August 31 would typically allow 4–8 weeks of lead time for squad registration and logistics. Conditioning on a qualifying announcement, September (0.33), August (0.23), and October (0.22) capture the core window, with November (0.09), July (0.06), and a 7% tail for December or later.

questions.title: Which Russian official will the Kremlin publicly confirm as attending Ali Khamenei's state funeral?
questions.background: Iran's supreme leader Ali Khamenei was killed on February 28, 2026.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the Russian official whose planned attendance at Ali Khamenei's state funeral is publicly confirmed by the Kremlin. Use the Kremlin's announcement or reliable reporting of it. This question concerns the announcement, not actual attendance. Resolution Date : 2026-07-02 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the official's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Iran rescheduled Ali Khamenei's state funeral to July 4-9, 2026, and President Pezeshkian only began issuing foreign invitations around June 23-24. Strong precedent favors State Duma Speaker Vyacheslav Volodin, whom the Kremlin sent to lead Russia's delegations to both Ebrahim Raisi's funeral (May 2024) and Pezeshkian's inauguration (July 2024), while Vladimir Putin is very unlikely to travel to Tehran shortly after a four-month air war. Because Khamenei was Supreme Leader and heads of government like Pakistan's PM are expected, Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin, Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov, Federation Council Chairwoman Valentina Matviyenko, and Security Council Secretary Sergei Shoigu are the main alternatives, leaving 16% tail mass on Putin, Dmitry Medvedev, Alexander Novak, or other envoys.

questions.title: Which NBA team will sign Trey Alexander to a two-way contract in the first two weeks of July 2026?
questions.background: A two-way contract allows a player to play for both an NBA team and its G League affiliate.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : as confirmed by a team announcement or contemporaneous sports reporting Resolution Date : Resolve to the NBA team that signs Trey Alexander to a two-way contract between July 1 and July 14, 2026, inclusive Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the team's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Trey Alexander (2024-25 G League Rookie of the Year with Denver) spent 2025-26 on a one-year two-way contract with the New Orleans Pelicans, shooting 51.4% FG and 50.0% 3PT in 9 NBA games while playing mainly for Birmingham, and enters the 2026 offseason as a Pelicans restricted two-way free agent per Spotrac. Incumbent RFA rights give New Orleans by far the highest single-team probability (32%) of re-signing him via qualifying offer or new two-way deal in early July, though coaching turnover and post-draft roster cycling leave a ~68% chance he signs elsewhere as Denver let him walk on July 3, 2025. Without specific external rumors as of June 24, the remaining 29 teams each carry low single-digit odds, with modest edges to hometown Oklahoma City, former club Denver, and rebuilding guard-needy teams like Brooklyn and Washington (53% left on the rest of the league).

questions.title: Which U.S. state will have the highest reported cyclospora case count by July 16, 2026?
questions.background: Cyclospora is a parasite that causes intestinal illness. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) monitors reported infections across U.S. states.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The latest CDC state-level data publicly available on July 16, 2026, reporting the cumulative number of cyclospora infections reported during 2026 Resolution Date : 2026-07-16 Accepted Answer Format : String (name of the U.S. state)
questions.current_reasoning: CDC cyclosporiasis surveillance (2018-2025) consistently shows Texas, New York (which includes NYC), and Florida recording the highest cumulative annual case counts; Texas logged 400-788 cases/yr in 2022-2024 (97% in May-Aug) and ramps up earliest due to Mexican produce supply chains, while New York led 2018-2021 genotyped isolates (651 vs Texas 551) and was top alongside Texas and North Carolina in 2025. As of June 18, 2026, FDA's CORE table shows only two small unresolved early-season Cyclospora clusters (8 and 2 cases), so by July 16 base rates heavily favor Texas, New York, and Florida, with 8% left on other states (e.g., North Carolina, Wisconsin, Minnesota, California) in case a localized outbreak hits elsewhere.

Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the company reported as holding the all-time record for the largest US initial public offering by a foreign company as of July 10, 2026. local_articles.snippet: SK hynix’s planned American depositary receipt (ADR) listing on the Nasdaq next month is drawing attention as a potential catalyst for easing the won’s prolonged weakness, with the won-dollar exchange rate having remained above the 1,500 won level for nearly a month. Market experts estimate the listing could bring in as much as $30 billion to Korea. Should those funds be converted into won, the resulting increase in dollar supply could help ease upward pressure on the exchange rate and support the local currency. The ADRs are scheduled to begin trading on July 10, with the subscription and settlement set for July 14. questions.title: What principal criminal penalty will Hannah Dugan receive at her initial sentencing for obstructing a federal proceeding?
questions.background: A federal jury convicted Wisconsin judge Hannah Dugan of obstructing a federal proceeding in December 2025. The case concerned her response to immigration agents seeking to arrest a defendant at her courthouse.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The federal court’s sentencing judgment or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the sentence announced in court. Resolution Conditions : Resolve when the federal district court first imposes a sentence for Dugan’s obstruction conviction. Identify the principal criminal penalty imposed at that sentencing. Subsequent appeals or resentencing do not change the answer. Accepted Answer Format : A short noun phrase naming the principal criminal penalty.
questions.current_reasoning: Former Milwaukee County Judge Hannah Dugan (67, no criminal record, resigned Jan. 3) is scheduled for sentencing on July 8, 2026 before U.S. District Judge Lynn Adelman after he denied her post-trial motion on June 16. AP and Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reporting consistently emphasize that federal guidelines generally call for probation for nonviolent first-time offenders and that Judge Adelman is nationally known for below-guidelines, non-custodial sentences. A prison sentence remains a meaningful secondary risk (~18%) given DOJ pressure, abuse-of-judicial-trust aggravators, and expected lack of contrition ahead of her Seventh Circuit appeal, alongside smaller chances for home confinement, a standalone fine, or time served.

questions.title: Who will Moldova’s parliament elect as prime minister to succeed Alexandru Munteanu?
questions.background: Alexandru Munteanu has resigned as Moldova’s prime minister, triggering his cabinet’s resignation. Moldova is pursuing European Union membership.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Moldovan parliamentary announcements or reliable news reporting confirming the election of a new prime minister. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the first person elected prime minister by Moldova’s parliament following Alexandru Munteanu’s resignation. A nomination or temporary appointment as acting prime minister does not qualify. Resolution Date : The date parliament elects the successor. Accepted Answer Format : The full name of the person elected.
questions.current_reasoning: Moldova's pro-EU ruling party PAS holds a 55/101 parliamentary majority alongside President Maia Sandu, so the successor to PM Alexandru Munteanu (whose Control Corps resigned over loss of trust on June 24, 2026) will be a PAS-backed pick. Top internal cabinet/party contenders are Deputy PM & Foreign Minister Mihai Popșoi, Deputy PM for European Integration Cristina Gherasimov (aligned with the EU accession priority), PAS leader and Speaker Igor Grosu, Deputy PM Vladimir Bolea, and Deputy PM for Economic Development Eugen Osmochescu. Because Sandu and PAS have a strong base rate of tapping surprise technocrats or presidential advisers (as with Dorin Recean in 2023 and Munteanu in Nov 2025), 42% probability mass is left outside the top five.

questions.title: Which player will command the highest transfer fee paid by a Premier League club during the 2026 summer transfer window?
questions.background: This question concerns completed transfers into Premier League clubs ahead of the 2026–27 season.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve using Al Jazeera Sport's reporting of completed transfers after England's 2026 summer transfer window closes. The answer is the player whose transfer fee, expressed in pounds sterling, is the highest paid by a Premier League club during that window. Exclude proposed or failed transfers. Accepted Answer Format : The player's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Major June 25-26 breakthrough (BBC Sport/Sami Mokbel, The Athletic/David Ornstein, Fabrizio Romano, Reuters, Press Association): Manchester City have reached a full club-to-club agreement with Nottingham Forest to sign England midfielder Elliot Anderson, with a US medical scheduled this weekend and personal terms not expected to be an issue. City sources put the fee at a club-record £116m guaranteed (tying Florian Wirtz as joint-2nd highest Premier League transfer ever), while Forest/PA/Telegraph/BBC report a potential British-record £130m total package eclipsing Alexander Isak's £125m move. Only one transfer in Premier League history has ever exceeded £116m. With ~93% deal-completion probability (small medical/World Cup injury snag risk before signing) and ~78-80% probability that no other Premier League club tops £116m-£130m over the remaining 67 days—especially with City's budget now spent, Liverpool's €100m (~£85m) Yan Diomande bid rejected by Leipzig (targeting Diomande + Barcola for ~£200m combined), Villa telling Arsenal Morgan Rogers is not for sale, and Julian Alvarez pushing for Barcelona—Elliot Anderson surges from 0.14 to 0.73, leaving 27% across Diomande (0.06), Rogers (0.04), Barcola (0.035), Bruno Guimaraes (0.02), and the wide field (0.115).
